definitions.explanation: A complaint, especially one made by a customer to a business about a product or service. Despite the English source word "claim," in Japanese the meaning has narrowed almost exclusively to negative feedback or grievances, not assertions or insurance claims.

examples.japanese: ⟦{客|きゃく}→客：00865_kyaku⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧クレーム⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{入|はい}った→入る：00494_hairu⟧。
examples.english: We got a complaint from a customer.

examples.japanese: ⟦{丁寧|ていねい}→丁寧：00896_teinei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧クレーム⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{対応|たいおう}→対応：02510_taiou⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。

⟦{商品|しょうひん}→商品：01436_shouhin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{不具合|ふぐあい}→不具合：06413_fuguai⟧⟦について→〜について：03103_nitsuite⟧、⟦メーカー→メーカー：11158_meekaa⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{直接|ちょくせつ}→直接：03499_chokusetsu⟧クレーム⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{付|つ}けた→付ける：00761_tsukeru⟧。
examples.english: I made a complaint directly to the manufacturer about the product defect.

notes:
From English "claim," but the Japanese meaning has narrowed to "complaint." English "claim" in the sense of asserting something or filing an insurance claim is NOT what クレーム means in Japanese — for those use ⟦{主張|しゅちょう}→主張：03220_shuchou⟧ or ⟦{請求|せいきゅう}→請求：03374_seikyuu⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- クレーム⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{付|つ}ける→付ける：00761_tsukeru⟧: to make a complaint
- クレーム⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入|い}れる→入れる：01098_ireru⟧: to put in a complaint
- クレーム⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧: a complaint comes in
- クレーム⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{対応|たいおう}→対応：02510_taiou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to handle a complaint
- クレーマー: a chronic complainer; difficult customer

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{苦情|くじょう}→苦情：00252_kujou⟧: complaint — native term, somewhat more formal
- ⟦{文句|もんく}→文句：03636_monku⟧: grumbling; gripe — more casual; often about everyday matters
- ⟦{抗議|こうぎ}→抗議：12807_kougi⟧: protest; formal objection — stronger and more public
